user.description: Pick your device. If it isn't listed, use it (step on the scale, or take a measurement) and try again: it only advertises right after a measurement.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? The device must be in Bluetooth mode (see the documentation).

key.description: The {device} only shares measurements with clients that know its secret key (kl), which is stored in your Withings account.

menu_options.login: Fetch the key with my Withings login

login.description:
Your credentials are sent only to Withings, once, to download the key. They are not stored. Accounts that use Google or Apple sign-in need a Withings password first.

To choose another option, leave both fields empty and submit.

manual.description:
Paste the {device}'s kl key, for example from the project's fetch_kl tool.

To use your Withings login instead, leave the field empty and submit.

pair.title: Pair with the {device}
pair.description:
The {device} only shares measurements over a paired Bluetooth connection, so Home Assistant has to pair with it once.

1. {wake_up}.
2. Choose *Pair now*. The {device} shows a 6-digit code, which you'll enter next.

Choose *Skip* if this Home Assistant is already paired with the {device}.

passkey.title: Enter the code
passkey.description: Type the 6-digit code shown on the {device}'s display. You have about 30 seconds.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description:
Pairing didn't complete: {error}.

{wake_up}, then try again.

pair_unsupported.title: Pairing not possible here
pair_unsupported.description:
Home Assistant reaches the {device} through an adapter that can't pair with a code: an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, or a system other than Linux (macOS pairs by itself when the device asks).

You can continue without pairing. If syncs fail later, make sure a Bluetooth adapter connected to this Home Assistant is close to the {device}, then use Reconfigure to pair.

pair_timeout.title: The {device} didn't show up
pair_timeout.description:
No advertisement from the {device} within 90 seconds.

{wake_up}, then try again. Make sure your phone's Bluetooth is off so the Withings app doesn't grab the {device}.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The device refused the connection because it isn't paired with this Home Assistant (for example after a battery change, or if the pairing was removed). Submit to pair again.

error.invalid_auth: Withings rejected the email or password.
error.no_scale: No device of this model was found on this Withings account.
error.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a valid key.
error.missing_credentials: Enter both email and password, or leave both empty to go back.
error.invalid_passkey: Enter the 6 digits shown on the display.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported device found. Use it so it advertises (step on the scale, or take a measurement), then try again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Done. The device is set up again.
abort.reauth_successful: Done. The device is paired again.

progress.wait_for_scale: {wake_up}. When the {device} shows a 6-digit code, the next step asks for it.
